text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's lunchtime! I'm gonna eat a 
ton!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Mmmph, delicious! Mild curry really is the 
best!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah...! At this rate, I can eat as 
much as I want!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Why is this happening...? Normally, I'd 
finish all of this without a problem...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Biko Pegasus is exhausted from 
running races back-to-back... I need to 
reconsider her upcoming race schedule.
